quote: complete a structured suicide risk assessment, ensure appropriate observation, and build a safety plan with her before any transition of care
problem: Q7 assigns the MS3 the entire suicide-risk chain as independent tasks: conducting the assessment, ensuring the observation level, and completing safety planning that gates a transition of care. Observation-level orders and disposition gating are resident/attending decisions, and the framing contradicts the page's own safety coaching ('Escalate to your supervising resident or attending rather than managing acuity alone'); the only escalation cue in this passage is conditional on the patient voicing self-harm thoughts. A student acting on this sentence could treat the observation decision and the safety plan as handled without team review.
replacement: complete a structured suicide risk assessment with your resident or attending, recommend an observation level to the team, and participate in building a safety plan with her before any transition of care
basis: Clerkship supervision norms (AAMC Core EPAs: students gather data and recommend; observation levels and transition-of-care decisions are ordered by the supervising physician) and the page's own topic_meta safety narration for this case.
